statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: GPU purchase order for AI Cloud Services entered after the FY2025 year end (August 2025), so recorded as outlook with fiscal_year null rather than inferring the fiscal year. The sentence gives two separate purchase amounts. This statement records the B200 order. The amounts are not summed. It is a purchase commitment, not capex already incurred.

statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: Second amount in the same sentence: the B300 GPU purchase agreement. Same caveats as the B200 statement. The amounts are not summed.

statements.quote: The increase in total commitments was primarily due to an increase in commitments related to our expansion into HPC and AI services and includes committed capital expenditure on computer hardware and infrastructure related to site development at Horizon 1 at the Childress site and the Sweetwater 1 data center site.
statements.notes: The sentence attributes the increase in committed future capital expenditure to HPC/AI expansion. The $368.8M total commitments figure is in the preceding sentence, which does not mention AI, so this is recorded as qualitative. The commitments are as of June 30, 2025 and relate to future spend, so recorded as outlook.

statements.quote: Cost of revenue - AI Cloud Services for the years ended June 30, 2025 and 2024 was $1.3 million and $0.4 million, respectively.
statements.notes: Cost of revenue for the AI Cloud segment (electricity, employee benefits, other direct expenses), excluding depreciation. It is reported as cost of revenue rather than operating expenses. Only the FY2025 figure is recorded; the FY2024 figure is a prior year.
